label: reading list
usage: books or articles they want to read, are reading, or finished
summary: user-defined reading-list items in one neutral list (name, fields{title,author,status,notes}, sources[])
sync_rule: Same title+author (or shared id) syncs into one entry with multiple sources[].
empty_msg: no reading-list sources configured (add a schema source under user-types/reading-list/)
deny_msg: denied: data grant for agent access to the reading list is not allowed

id.description: durable identifier when the source supplies one (ISBN, URL, row id)
